entries.reason: the Crystal Canyon promo code that was GOLEM and is now APPLE is ONE code with an alias: players who redeemed it under the old key hold codes.GOLEM = true in their DataStore saves, and without the alias a rename lets them redeem it again (+1000 coins) and shows old saves as unredeemed. The spec pins that behaviour.
entries.removal: when the owner decides saves written before the rename no longer need to load (nobody holds codes.GOLEM): delete the Aliases entry from CodeTable.luau, the alias fold in Profile.sanitize, and the spec cases; the old key then becomes an unknown code
